details:
I'm able to get to the hub by starting the game in vr mode (Unable to in desktop mode) when I try to go to a world I see the world from a different point of view than where the spawn is. I closed the game and verified the integrity of the game files through steam, 1 file failed to validate, it was 3.2 kb. After reacquiring the file I was able to get into a world by starting a new instance (Have not tried this before) I then tried to go to the great pug and encountered the loading loop bug again (And again, It showed me in a location other than the spawn) after exiting the game, I verified the files and the same 3.2 kb file failed to validate, I have not launched the game since the second validation attempt. I hope this might help in solving the situation.

Update, I just started up VRchat, I was able to get into a pre-existing world with only one person in it, I got my avatar and went to the worlds menu, I was going to try to join the great pug again when I noticed that it said the max amount of players was 28, but I was seeing rooms with over 70 players, I couldn't find a room with less than 31 players in it. That seems a little strange, doesn't it? I successfully joined the great pug by creating a new instance and am now waiting for other people to join it.

I've been looking at other popular worlds to see if the same thing is happening, it is. Gaia nights has a player cap of 30, Room #7465 currently has 98 people in it, The hub has a player cap of 16, Room #9155 currently has 42 people in it, The Presentation room has a player cap of 32, Room #7772 currently has 66 players in it. perhaps it is a UI bug, but it could have something to do with the slew of people encountering the loading loop bug.

I have just noticed something else. When I went to the social menu to check if any of my friends were online, all but the "In room" tab disappeared, it would not display the "Offline Friends" or the "Online Friends" tabs, I closed the menu and opened it but to no avail, they were still gone.
title: Loading Loop Bug
